$comment: SDKs the PR benchmark job (benches/sdks/ci.ts) always measures. `runtime` SDKs are built (tsrs + bundle-lib) and probed; `bundle` SDKs are only bundled from src/, which needs no build. SDKs a PR changes are added to both sets; a changed SDK whose src/ is over `runtimeMaxSrcMB` is only bundled, because its bundle-lib build alone takes longer than the job budget.
$providers: Whole SDKs whose every service module is imported in one process (what Alchemy loads). Built only when their inputs differ from the run in --reuse; otherwise that run's numbers are copied.
